reconfigure.title: Legrand/Bticino Smarther - Reconfigure
reconfigure.description: What would you like to reconfigure?

reconfigure_devices.description:
The thermostats currently on your Legrand plant(s) have been re-scanned. Checked items are the ones currently added. Check new thermostats to add them, or uncheck to remove them.

Removed thermostats become "unavailable" and can then be deleted from the device page. Their history and the still-selected devices are preserved.
reconfigure_devices.title: Legrand/Bticino Smarther - Add / Remove Thermostats

reconfigure_url.description:
Update the Home Assistant external URL used as the C2C webhook target. The current value is: {current_url}

Changing it retargets the Legrand push subscription to the new URL and removes the old one. No re-authentication or device re-selection is needed.
reconfigure_url.title: Legrand/Bticino Smarther - Change Webhook URL

reconfigure_credentials.description:
Renew the Legrand developer credentials. The current values are pre-filled - edit the ones that changed. After submitting you will be asked to authorize again in your browser (the same steps as first setup) to obtain fresh tokens.

Your external URL and selected thermostats are preserved. The integration keeps running on the current credentials until the new ones are validated.
reconfigure_credentials.title: Legrand/Bticino Smarther - Renew Credentials

data.url_warning: Ignore and Continue - I understand that no support for login issues is provided for bypassing this warning.

url_warning.description:
The HA server cannot connect to the provided URL: {hass_url}.
> {error}

To fix this, please confirm your **HA server** can reach {hass_url}. This field is from the External URL under Configuration -> General, but you can try your internal URL.

If you are **certain** your client can reach this URL, you can bypass this warning and use legacy auth.
url_warning.title: Legrand/Bticino Smarther - Unable to Connect to HA URL

data.legacy_mode: Legacy Mode (Use external site for auth only if your HA is not reachable from the internet)
